tournaments.title: NexusX Solo Vanguard Cup — S1
tournaments.description: High-intensity BGMI Solo competition designed to test individual positioning, gunplay, and late-zone decision making across India.
tournaments.eligibleDevices: Handset Mobile Smartphones Only (No Emulators / Tablets)
eligibility: Valid Battlegrounds Mobile India (BGMI) account registered in India.
Mobile smartphone only — emulators, tablets, and external triggers are prohibited.
Players must compete using the exact IGN and Character ID submitted in the registration form.

registration.instructions: Submit your BGMI IGN and Character ID accurately in the Google Form. Join the community channel for Room ID & Password updates.

prizes.other: Details published on official results confirmation

rules: Only mobile smartphones are permitted. Emulators, iPads, triggers, and unauthorized overlays are banned.
Players must check in by the published reporting time in IST.
Teaming in Solo lobbies results in immediate disqualification.
Screen recording (POV) may be requested by tournament administrators for verification.

tournaments.title: NexusX India Squad Championship — S1
tournaments.description: Structured 4-player BGMI Squad tournament built for coordinated team rotations, disciplined IGL calls, and competitive Indian lobbies.
tournaments.eligibleDevices: Handset Mobile Smartphones Only (No Emulators / Tablets)
eligibility: Complete squad roster submitted via the official Google Form prior to deadline.
All roster players must comply with mobile-only device rules.
No unverified stand-ins or ringers permitted after registration closes.

squadDetails.teamRequirements: Each squad must register a consistent team name, tag, and up to the configured roster limit.
squadDetails.captainRequirements: Team captain acts as the primary point of contact for check-in, Room ID updates, and match screenshot reporting.
squadDetails.playerRequirements: Every player must enter custom lobbies with the exact BGMI IGN and Character ID listed on the registration form.

registration.instructions: Team Captain should submit the complete squad details via the official Google Form and stay active in the WhatsApp community.

prizes.other: Verified standings required prior to prize payout

rules: All registered roster members must join the match room on time using their registered BGMI accounts.
Bug abuse, glitch exploitation, stream sniping, or third-party modifications result in immediate team disqualification.
Team captains must retain end-of-match scoreboard screenshots if requested by organizers.
Organizer decisions on match disputes and rule enforcement are final.

tournaments.title: SOLO CLUTCHER
tournaments.description:
Welcome to the NexusX Esports India - SOLO CLUTCHER Showdown! Register for free, showcase your solo survival skills, and win instant cash prizes.

🏆 PRIZE POOL BREAKDOWN (Total ₹100):
• 1st Place: ₹50
• 2nd Place: ₹30
• 3rd Place: ₹20

⚠️ TOURNAMENT RULES:
• Mobile Devices Only (Emulators & iPads are strictly banned).
• Minimum BGMI Account Level: 30+.
• Zero tolerance for hacking, GFX tools, or teaming up in Solo mode.
• Room ID & Password will be shared 10 minutes before the match on our official WhatsApp Group & Discord Server.
• Top 3 winners must submit their match result screenshot to claim prizes.
